card.title: qFit at scale
card.summary: qFit was run on almost 80,000 high-resolution PDB structures, giving over 60,000 multiconformer models, the largest experimentally derived ensemble dataset to date. Most models fit the data better than the re-refined deposited structures and reveal side-chain heterogeneity that the deposited models leave out.

paper.title: Recovering Conformational Heterogeneity from the Protein Data Bank at Scale: An Ensemble Dataset of over 60,000 Structures

c9.text: reframes the experimental data deposited in the PDB as a source of ensemble information

resources.label: ExcitedStates/qfit-3.0
resources.note: qFit code and the pipeline scripts and parameters used here

nodes.title: QUE - Can experimental structural data supply the ensemble training data that ensemble predictors lack?
nodes.desc: Ensemble predictors need many examples of weighted conformational states. The paper asks whether X-ray and cryo-EM data already in the PDB can provide them.

nodes.title: QUE - Can heterogeneity hidden in deposited PDB data be recovered automatically across the PDB?
nodes.desc: Manual multiconformer modeling in Coot is slow and hard to scale. The paper tests whether qFit can do it for tens of thousands of structures.

nodes.title: QUE - Do qFit multiconformer models fit the experimental data better than the deposited models?
nodes.desc: Fit is measured by Rfree, compared between each qFit model and the matching re-refined PDB-REDO model.
nodes.loc: Results: 'Multiconformer models improve fit to experimental data'

nodes.title: QUE - How much more conformational heterogeneity do qFit models contain than deposited models?
nodes.desc: Measured per residue as the change in the number of alternate conformations (altlocs) and in RMSF.
nodes.loc: Results: 'Multiconformer models have significantly more conformational heterogeneity compared to static structures'

nodes.title: CLM - Ensemble prediction is held back by scarce training data
nodes.desc: Current ensemble predictors are trained and benchmarked on molecular dynamics data. Simulations are limited by force field accuracy, accessible timescales and the diversity of systems simulated.

nodes.title: CLM - Crystallographic data capture heterogeneity regardless of timescale, unlike finite MD trajectories
nodes.desc: MD gives time-ordered trajectories but undersamples microsecond to millisecond motions; ATLAS, for example, has three 100 ns trajectories per protein. X-ray data report the equilibrium distribution in the crystal but carry no time information and are biased by the crystal environment.
nodes.loc: Related datasets of conformational heterogeneity, paragraph 3

nodes.title: CLM - The qFit dataset is the largest set of experimentally derived multiconformer protein models to date
nodes.desc: It covers broad sequence and structural diversity and adds experimental ensemble data to training resources that are mostly MD-derived (ATLAS, mdCATH, MISATO, GPCRmd, IDRome).
nodes.loc: Purpose; Related datasets of conformational heterogeneity, paragraph 2; Impact, paragraph 1

nodes.title: CLM - The PDB's deposited experimental data are a source of ensemble information
nodes.desc: In most cases the experimental data are too rich to be described by one conformation. Releasing multiconformer models at scale lowers the barrier to using dynamics in routine structural analysis.

nodes.title: CLM - Training on single-conformer models may teach predictors local geometric distortions
nodes.desc: Modeling a multi-state residue as one conformer introduces strain. The author proposes, as a possibility, that ensemble training data could help with these artifacts and with the 'last angstrom' gap in side-chain and bond geometry.

nodes.title: CLM - Conventional refinement collapses ensemble-averaged data into one structure, so most PDB entries leave heterogeneity unmodeled
nodes.desc: X-ray and cryo-EM average over many molecules in space and time, but most depositions report a single set of coordinates. Where altlocs are deposited, modeling is uneven across the protein.
nodes.loc: Background, paragraph 3; Related datasets of conformational heterogeneity, paragraph 1

nodes.title: CLM - qFit can build multiconformer models automatically across tens of thousands of PDB structures
nodes.desc: Starting from PDB-REDO structures at 2 Å or better with structure factors, the pipeline re-refined each model, ran qFit and refined again without manual steps.

nodes.title: CLM - The dataset is limited to high-resolution crystal data and mostly captures side-chain motion
nodes.desc: Only structures better than 2 Å with structure factors are included. Most carry crystal packing and cryogenic constraints, and the heterogeneity found is mostly in side chains rather than the backbone.

nodes.title: CLM - qFit models fit the experimental data better than re-refined deposited models for most structures
nodes.desc: The average Rfree gain is small but reflects modeled heterogeneity. Poor solvent fitting around heterogeneous models partly hides the improvement.
nodes.loc: Results: 'Multiconformer models improve fit to experimental data', Figure 3

nodes.title: CLM - qFit models contain widespread side-chain heterogeneity absent from deposited models
nodes.desc: qFit adds alternate conformations to a minority of residues across the dataset, with the largest spread in long side chains.
nodes.loc: Purpose; Results: 'Multiconformer models have significantly more conformational heterogeneity...', Figure 4

nodes.title: CLM - Structures with typical, good refinement statistics can still hide unmodeled heterogeneity
nodes.desc: A deposited model with median-like resolution and R values and no altlocs can still have density that supports multiple conformations.
nodes.loc: Results: 'Hidden heterogeneity in a high-quality structure', Figure 5

nodes.title: EVD - 16,133 sequence clusters at 30% identity and 6,590 Foldseek structural clusters
nodes.desc: MMseqs2 gave 16,133 clusters at 30% sequence identity (many singletons) and 25,608 at 90%. Foldseek gave 6,590 structural clusters.

nodes.title: EVD - Re-refined deposited models have a median Rfree of 0.198
nodes.desc: Median Rfree 0.198 (range 0.06 to 0.71) and median Rwork 0.17 (range 0.06 to 0.68). Rfree rises modestly with worse resolution (slope 0.062, R² = 0.22). The roughly 20% residual partly reflects reducing ensemble-averaged data to one discrete model.

nodes.title: EVD - 60,549 of 79,833 structures produced completed qFit models
nodes.desc: 80,876 PDB-REDO structures at 2 Å or better were downloaded; 1,043 nucleic-acid-only structures were removed. Of the 79,833 that entered the pipeline, 60,549 (reported as 85.9%) completed.

nodes.title: EVD - Completed models have a median resolution of 1.70 Å and a median of 298 residues
nodes.desc: Resolution ranges from 0.5 to 2.0 Å, residue count from 3 to 2,338, and chain count from 1 to 36.

nodes.title: EVD - qFit lowered Rfree for 54,274 of 60,549 structures (89.7%)
nodes.desc: Mean Rfree change was -0.009 and median -0.01. Per-structure changes ranged from a 0.320 decrease to a 0.310 increase (SD 0.026). The Purpose section gives 83.7% for this fraction.
nodes.loc: Results: 'Multiconformer models improve fit to experimental data', Figure 3A-B

nodes.title: EVD - 802 structures (1.3%) had Rfree rise by more than 0.05 after qFit
nodes.desc: No pattern was found that explains the increase in these structures.
nodes.loc: Results: 'Multiconformer models improve fit to experimental data', Figure 3

nodes.title: EVD - qFit increased the altloc count for 9.4% of residues
nodes.desc: 90.4% of residues had one altloc in both models. Gains were +1 for 4.9%, +2 for 3.6% and +3 for 0.8% of residues; 0.2% lost altlocs. Leucine and cysteine gained the most (mean 0.16), glycine and alanine the least (mean 0.11).
nodes.loc: Results: 'Multiconformer models have significantly more conformational heterogeneity...', Figure 4A, Supplementary Figure 1

nodes.title: EVD - qFit increased per-residue RMSF by a mean of 0.13 Å (median 0)
nodes.desc: A small subset of residues shows large RMSF gains. Mean gains were largest for lysine (0.23 Å) and arginine (0.20 Å) and smallest for glycine (0.05 Å), alanine (0.06 Å) and proline (0.08 Å).
nodes.loc: Results: 'Multiconformer models have significantly more conformational heterogeneity...', Figure 4B, Supplementary Figure 2

nodes.title: EVD - In DAPK1 (7CCU), qFit lowered Rfree from 0.189 to 0.1812 and added altlocs to 164 of 277 residues
nodes.desc: The 1.65 Å deposited model has no altlocs; Rwork fell from 0.172 to 0.159. 85 of 277 residues had more than 2 altlocs. Removing altlocs within the same rotamer well leaves 144/277 (52%) and 48/277 (17.3%).
nodes.loc: Results: 'Hidden heterogeneity in a high-quality structure', Figure 5A

nodes.title: EVD - Phe240, Asp220 and Glu118 in 7CCU show density for multiple conformations
nodes.desc: Each had a single conformation in the deposited model. Density contoured at 0.5σ supports the alternate conformations qFit placed.
nodes.loc: Results: 'Hidden heterogeneity in a high-quality structure', Figure 5B-D

nodes.title: STU - Sequence and structural clustering of the completed dataset
nodes.desc: Clustering of the 60,549 completed entries by sequence identity and by structure to assess diversity.

nodes.title: STU - qFit pipeline run on 79,833 PDB-REDO structures at 2 Å or better
nodes.desc: Every structure was re-refined, modeled with qFit and refined again. The re-refined structure serves as the 'deposited' comparison.

nodes.title: STU - Per-structure Rfree comparison of qFit and re-refined deposited models
nodes.desc: Rfree of each qFit model compared with its matching re-refined PDB-REDO model across 60,549 structures.
nodes.loc: Results: 'Multiconformer models improve fit to experimental data'

nodes.title: STU - Per-residue altloc and RMSF comparison across the dataset
nodes.desc: Altloc counts and RMSF compared residue by residue between qFit and deposited models, overall and by amino acid type.
nodes.loc: Results: 'Multiconformer models have significantly more conformational heterogeneity...'

nodes.title: STU - Case study of DAPK1 with resveratrol (PDB 7CCU)
nodes.desc: Refinement statistics and residue-level electron density compared between the deposited and qFit models of one median-quality structure.
nodes.loc: Results: 'Hidden heterogeneity in a high-quality structure'

nodes.title: PRO - MMseqs2 sequence clustering and Foldseek structural clustering
nodes.desc: Sequence clustering at 30% and 90% identity with MMseqs2; structural clustering with Foldseek.

nodes.title: PRO - Dataset selection from PDB-REDO
nodes.desc: All PDB-REDO structures at 2 Å or better with deposited structure factors, downloaded December 2024 (n = 80,876). Structures made only of nucleic acids were removed (n = 1,043).

nodes.title: PRO - phenix.refine re-refinement and final refinement
nodes.desc: Five macro cycles with NQH flips, isotropic individual ADPs, riding hydrogens, ordered solvent updated every macro cycle, and optimized xyz and ADP weights. The same settings are used for the re-refined and the post-qFit models.

nodes.title: PRO - qFit 2025.3 multiconformer modeling on a composite omit map
nodes.desc: qFit run with default parameters on a composite omit map, followed by the post-qFit refinement script. Code and parameters are in the qFit repository.

nodes.title: PRO - Per-residue RMSF and altloc count metrics
nodes.desc: RMSF measures the spatial spread of atom positions across modeled conformers. Altloc count is the number of discrete alternate conformations per residue.
nodes.loc: Results: 'Multiconformer models have significantly more conformational heterogeneity...', paragraph 1

nodes.title: REQ - Improve qFit and combine it with guidance methods to build a self-reinforcing training loop
nodes.desc: qFit-derived training data improve ensemble predictors; guided predictors then find richer heterogeneity, which yields better training data.

nodes.title: REQ - Extend PDBx/mmCIF to encode conformational and compositional heterogeneity
nodes.desc: The current format does not describe this heterogeneity well, so much of it cannot be shared even when it is modeled.

nodes.title: REQ - Build a living database to share, query and compare ensemble models
nodes.desc: It would treat experimental data as ground truth and take in modeling improvements as they appear, so they reach downstream users.

nodes.title: REQ - Explain why qFit worsens Rfree for 1.3% of structures
nodes.desc: The author names the cause of the Rfree increase in these 802 structures as the subject of ongoing work.
nodes.loc: Results: 'Multiconformer models improve fit to experimental data'
